item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
• Fuller app icon — the icon now fills its tile edge-to-edge in the Dock, Activity Monitor and Finder.
  • Everything from 1.1.x: AI session analysis (Claude / GPT / Gemini) with charts and token counts, session history, React Native screen tracking, refreshed 3D settings icons, and a What's New screen.
